test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Defeat’ in the given sentence.

The first battle of Panipat was fought on 21 April 1526, where Babur introduced cannon warfare and was able to gain victory on Delhi and subjugated sultanate ruler Ibrahim Lodi.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'victory'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Defeat"** means the act of losing or being overcome in a battle, contest, or struggle. (पराजय)

 
 
• **Example: **The team faced a crushing defeat in the final match.
 
 
 
• **"Victory" **refers to the act of winning or triumphing over an opponent or challenge. (जीत)
 
 
• **Example: **Her victory in the competition was celebrated by everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Defeat' **is **'Victory'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'victory'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Subjugated **(वश में किया हुआ): To bring under domination or control, especially by conquest.

 
 
• **Example:** The invaders quickly subjugated the local population.
 
 
 
• **Warfare **(युद्ध): Engagement in or the activities involved in war or conflict.
 
 
• **Example: **Modern warfare involves a lot of technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Gain** (प्राप्त करना): To obtain or secure something desired.
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to gain the respect of his peers through hard work.
